record.original_question: Does every sink-free finite digraph D have a quasi-kernel Q with size at most |V(D)|/2? Here a quasi-kernel is an independent vertex set Q such that every vertex outside Q can reach some vertex of Q by a directed path of length one or two.

evidence.quote: An independent set X of a digraph D is a quasi-kernel if for every y 6∈ X, either there is x ∈ X such that y→x or there are x ∈ X and z 6∈ X such that y→z→x.
Conjecture 6.1 Every sink-free digraph D = (V (D), A(D)) has a quasi-kernel of size at most |V (D)| 2 .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let D = (V(D), A(D)) be a finite directed graph (no loops or multiple arcs) that is sink-free, meaning every vertex has out-degree at least 1. A quasi-kernel of D is a subset Q ⊆ V(D) such that:
(i) Q is independent in D, i.e. for all distinct u, v ∈ Q, neither (u,v) nor (v,u) is an arc of D; and
(ii) for every vertex y ∈ V(D) \ Q, either there exists x ∈ Q with (y,x) ∈ A(D), or there exist z ∈ V(D) \ Q and x ∈ Q with (y,z), (z,x) ∈ A(D) (equivalently, every vertex outside Q can reach some vertex of Q by a directed path of length 1 or 2).

Prove or disprove: every sink-free finite digraph D admits a quasi-kernel Q with |Q| ≤ |V(D)|/2.
artifact.status_search_result: The small quasi-kernel conjecture, due to Erdős and Székely (1976), remains open in general. It has been verified for restricted classes of digraphs, including semicomplete multipartite, quasi-transitive, locally semicomplete digraphs, split graphs, and digraphs with chromatic number at most 4 (Kostochka–Luo–Shan and subsequent works), but the full conjecture is unresolved as of recent surveys.

status_evidence.title: On the Small Quasi-kernel conjecture — a survey
status_evidence.snippet: The conjecture remains largely open; verified only for narrow classes such as semicomplete multipartite, quasi-transitive, locally semicomplete digraphs.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is open in general, proven only for restricted classes.

status_evidence.title: Towards the Small Quasi-Kernel Conjecture (Kostochka, Luo, Shan)
status_evidence.snippet: Confirms the conjecture for digraphs with chromatic number at most 4.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress: conjecture holds for digraphs with chromatic number ≤ 4.

status_evidence.title: Results on the Small Quasi-Kernel Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Further partial results toward the conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial results, but conjecture not fully resolved.
